Nadia, the answer is 280 seats, and I've replied in the #strategic-pod thread.

Gideon's July 1 update first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280 active seats on the production roster. The 300 had counted sandbox logins from the May rollout. Ruth acknowledged the 280.

His correction doesn't name Vantorre. It says "Nadia's old industrial account" and comes right after the Vantorre post, so I read it as Vantorre. The count is as of Jul 1 and may have changed since.
